title: Sharing metric views with OpenSharing is now generally available
body: Sharing metric views with OpenSharing is now generally available. Add metric views to a share and query them with `MEASURE(...)` on serverless compute. See [Add metric views to a share](/aws/en/opensharing/create-share#metric-views) and [Read shared metric views](/aws/en/opensharing/read-data-databricks#metric-views).

ref_links.text: Add metric views to a share
